description: Unit tests for CookieInclusionStatus class, testing exclusion and warning reasons handling, including adding, removing, and validating reasons, as well as specific behaviors like downgrade metrics and user preferences exclusion.

classes.name: CookieInclusionStatus
classes.description: Represents the inclusion/exclusion status of cookies, including reasons for exclusion and warnings, with methods to manipulate and query reasons.

methods.name: AddExclusionReason
methods.description: Adds an exclusion reason to the status.

methods.name: AddWarningReason
methods.description: Adds a warning reason to the status.

methods.name: HasExclusionReason
methods.description: Checks if a specific exclusion reason is present.

methods.name: HasWarningReason
methods.description: Checks if a specific warning reason is present.

methods.name: HasOnlyExclusionReason
methods.description: Checks if only a specific exclusion reason is present.

methods.name: IsInclude
methods.description: Determines if the status indicates inclusion.

methods.name: ShouldWarn
methods.description: Checks if warnings should be issued.

methods.name: HasExactlyExclusionReasonsForTesting
methods.description: Checks if the exclusion reasons match exactly a given set (testing).

methods.name: HasExactlyWarningReasonsForTesting
methods.description: Checks if the warning reasons match exactly a given set (testing).

methods.name: MakeFromReasonsForTesting
methods.description: Creates a status object from specified reasons (testing).

methods.name: ShouldRecordDowngradeMetrics
methods.description: Determines if downgrade metrics should be recorded based on reasons.

methods.name: RemoveExclusionReasons
methods.description: Removes multiple exclusion reasons at once.

methods.name: ValidateExclusionAndWarningFromWire
methods.description: Validates exclusion and warning reasons from wire format.

methods.name: ExcludedByUserPreferences
methods.description: Checks if the status indicates exclusion due to user preferences.
